Works with Claude

Let Claude make your avatar

Need a character for your Roblox game? Tell Claude what you want. It opens this studio, picks hair and a face, paints the outfit with Gemini (Nano Banana), puts it on your character and hands you the Roblox R6 file.

Use https://grugdigital.com/character/ to make a female character wearing a warm fall outfit. Paint the outfit in Gemini, then download the Roblox R6 file for me.
Open Claude
  1. 1Paste the prompt into a Claude chat.
  2. 2Claude builds the character here and paints the outfit in Gemini.
  3. 3You get a rigged R6 .glb, ready for Roblox Studio's 3D Importer.

Claude needs a browser it can use (Claude in Chrome) to do this for you, and for custom outfits you need to be signed in to Gemini in that browser. Without one, Claude gives you a link that opens this studio with your character already set up.

Building a Roblox game? Download the Claude skill so Claude makes your NPCs here whenever your game needs characters. Add it in Claude under Customize › Skills (+ › Create skill › Upload a skill).

Instructions for Claude and other AI agents

AI agent reading this page: you were asked to make a Roblox character with this studio. The job has three parts and all three are required: (1) hair and face, (2) a custom shirt and pants painted in Gemini (Nano Banana), (3) the R6 .glb download. A character in the starter tee is not finished, and downloadR6() refuses until a painted outfit is worn. This is a browser app (WebGL): use a real browser (Claude in Chrome, computer use or Playwright), in the person's own Chrome if you can, since that is where they are signed in to Gemini. Full guide: https://grugdigital.com/character/claude.md.

  1. Open this page in a tab and run await GrugStudio.whenReady.
  2. Choose a look that fits the request (don't quiz the person): await GrugStudio.set({name, skin, head, hair, hairColor, eyes, brows, mouth}). GrugStudio.options() lists every choice.
  3. Turn the request into a concrete outfit and open the painting steps: await GrugStudio.paintOutfit('rust-orange chunky knit sweater, mustard plaid scarf, dark-wash jeans, brown suede ankle boots').
  4. Click the studio's Copy picture button (a real click: copying from code doesn't work).
  5. Open https://gemini.google.com/app in a new tab, click the message box and press Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac). A thumbnail of two grey blocky avatars appears.
  6. Back in the studio, click Copy prompt. In Gemini, click the message box and press Ctrl+V. Don't type the prompt: it has line breaks and Enter would send it early.
  7. Click Gemini's Send button and wait 20 to 60 seconds for the painted picture.
  8. Hover the painted picture in Gemini and click its Copy image button.
  9. Back in the studio, click the 3D view and press Ctrl+V. The alignment sheet opens; GrugStudio.status().match should be 0.85 or more.
  10. Click Wear it, take a screenshot to check, then await GrugStudio.downloadR6() saves <Name>.glb. Give it to the person (it lands in their Downloads folder).

No browser at all? Send the person a recipe link instead, e.g. https://grugdigital.com/character/?name=Maple&hair=wavy-long&hairColor=chestnut&eyes=lashes&outfit=cozy+fall+sweater, and walk them through steps 4 to 10.

Downloads

The .glb is an R6 rig (HumanoidRootPart, Torso, Head, Right/Left Arm, Right/Left Leg) with studs, hair and normal maps: import it with Studio's 3D Importer and add a Humanoid. If the parts arrive wrapped in Models or without joints, select the model and run the setup script in the Command Bar. The .zip has the .glb, the script, shirt.png, pants.png, the face texture and a preview.

Uploading to Roblox
  1. Shirt and pants are 585 × 559 PNGs with transparent gaps.
  2. Creator Hub → Avatar Items → upload shirt.png as a Shirt and pants.png as Pants.
  3. The head keeps the classic top, so Roblox hats sit on it as usual.

Library

Pick a folder for your outfits. Each outfit is saved as its own folder with shirt.png, pants.png, a preview and its tags, so you can sort it into folders like Girls / Pink or Cosplay.

This browser can't open folders on disk (Chrome and Edge can). Browser storage still works, and every outfit can be downloaded as a .zip.

Starter folders

Sorting checks every outfit at the top level (or in an Unsorted folder) and moves it to the folder whose names best match its tags, name and colors.
